direction.name: 收藏画册 · iOS系统色
direction.mood: 成人向、克制、图片主导；UI采用系统色
principles: 完整原图可随时查看；官方未完成姓名与故事文本在提交通过后揭晓
每个页面一个主要动作

typography.family: iOS system; Dynamic Type semantic roles

motion.reduced: no displacement; short fade or immediate change

components.tray_order: shuffle on new game; persist order and restore it unchanged

puzzle.placement: difficulty-based visible grid; neutral snapping to every cell; no answer checking during placement
puzzle.validation: exact slot identity only at submit; overall result only; failure preserves all slots
puzzle.zoom: fit or enlarged board; browse mode temporarily disables piece grabs so full board can pan even when occupied
puzzle.occupied_cell: board piece swaps with occupied piece; tray piece replaces occupied piece and returns old piece to tray
puzzle.tray: four columns, four visible rows; all remaining pieces rendered; vertical scroll and offset persistence
puzzle.keyboard: Enter places in middle cell; arrows move one cell; Delete returns piece to tray
puzzle.save_migration: prior free coordinates mapped to nearest containing cell; colliding pieces returned to tray; no correctness-based relocation

creator.storage: IndexedDB library, drafts and immutable image versions; localStorage progress
creator.image_processing: EXIF-aware decode; aspect-preserving 4:3 crop with x/y/zoom or full-image containment; preview same baked scene used by puzzle
creator.ordering: drag row or explicit accessible up/down controls
creator.quiz: optional; three distinct options and one chosen correct answer
creator.revision: new image/crop creates new immutable version; metadata updates same version; current puzzle references original version
creator.privacy: local browser import, no remote upload
creator.trial: no achievements; restore previous game on exit or page reload; draft retains image settings

layout.grid: 4:3 scene;12=4×3,24=6×4,48=8×6; enlarged board for small pieces
layout.page_width: adaptive safe area; do not hard-code status bar or home indicator
responsive_rules: small phone collapses auxiliary tools before reducing puzzle touch targets
optional tablet uses board left and tray right
story pages scroll; puzzle stage remains touch-stable

composition_rules: collection grid allowed for peer artworks
imagery_rules: keep crucial story clues within centered square safe crop
runtime puzzle masks; do not generate individual fragments independently
data_visualization_rules: no competitive dashboard in first release
anti_patterns: art as control background without contrast plate

accessibility.contrast_policy: minimum 4.5:1 normal text / 3:1 large text and functional outlines; final art requires separate QA
accessibility.keyboard_policy: Arrow keys move to adjacent cell; Enter places in middle cell; Delete returns to tray; no correct-target navigation. Native VoiceOver needs device checks.
accessibility.focus_policy: restore focus on sheet dismissal; move focus to new screen heading; no answer leak in alt labels
accessibility.reduced_motion_policy: replace movement with short fade; no particles

governance.token_policy: use semantic roles; update this contract before adding styles
governance.component_policy: shared component-map owns anatomy and states
governance.when_to_add_new_tokens: existing semantic token cannot express verified new requirement
governance.when_to_add_new_components: new workflow or reusable behavior needs a defined state and accessibility contract

open_questions: art style confirmation; built-in image generation tool unavailable in current session

generation_status.user_choice: 用户选择等内置生图工具可用后再生成；不使用API备用方式

implementation.native_import: PHPicker and UIDocumentPicker; selected files only
implementation.signing: unsigned device build in macOS GitHub Actions
implementation.trial_backup: persistent localStorage backup restored on WebView rebuild or cold launch
implementation.text_size: native Dynamic Type scale for reading, headings, questions and form input

miniprogram.storage: wx storage + persistent local files; no upload
